notes: PleaToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named plea (PLEA) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire 1,000,000,000-token supply once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no owner, further minting, pause, blacklist or transfer fee. No additional application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
